is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports the kdr Leu-Phe mutation (Vgsc L995F) in Anopheles gambiae (page 4, 7, 9).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for the kdr mutation in four villages (page 9).

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted on field-collected mosquitoes in the Plateau region of Benin (page 2, 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study conducted by the authors (page 2, 4).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies four villages: Itakpako, Itassoumba, Djohounkollé, and Ko-Koumolou (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was carried out from July 2011 to June 2012 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes original field collections conducted by the authors in 2011-2012.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the impact of land-use (fishponds and market gardening) on malaria transmission and insecticide resistance in four villages in southeastern Benin. It reports kdr (L995F) genotype frequencies for Anopheles gambiae s.s. populations collected in 2011-2012, alongside WHO susceptibility bioassay results.
